75: We have as the text: If one found an item on which there is no distinguishing mark alongside an item on which there is a distinguishing mark - for example, money in front of a pouch.
He is obligated to proclaim - all of it; the money shall be given to the owner of the pouch.
The owner of the item with the distinguishing mark came and took his - [that is,] the pouch, and said that the money is not mine -- the other one [i.e. the finder] is entitled to the money.
